Akshay Deshpande

DevOps engineer & product builder · Goa, India

I’m a DevOps engineer at Siemens. I build cloud infrastructure, delivery systems, and AI tools that help teams take ideas into production.

My work spans AWS and Azure, Kubernetes, infrastructure as code, and the operational details that make a platform reliable. Before Siemens, I worked at Zaggle, automating delivery for more than 60 microservices across four business verticals.

I also build independent projects: Lemma, an AI control plane for cloud operations, and eksp, an EKS platform with security, scaling, and observability built into its foundations.
